items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I dedicated one of the numbers to my old friend Sonny Howard.

ctx.x: Yes. How did you meet him? You heard him play.

I heard Art Tatum as the other people heard him, playing as I said in these jam sessions. All musicians at that time liked to play jazz music played every chance they got. Any place there was a piano, a piano player sat down and played, and some other guys joined him, and they all kinds of places where it was known to be a headquarters for musicians to have these jam sessions. And Art Tatum was at that. Not only that, but I lived with a very, very wonderful man and his wife who always had these little private…
One of the finest gentlemen I ever met in my life, you know.
